thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P0] elevated 5xx rate from inference-gateway-eu (observed 2:34 UTC) -- paging Mae (oncall) and Ravi. Root cause unknown, mitigation in progress.
Mae (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs + checking recent deploys. ETA 5m.
Ravi: I'll rerun the traffic split to fall back to gen-small for EU while we triage. tagging @ops-liaison for any capacity concerns.
Mae (oncall): quick checks: no new deploys in the last 30m, autoscaler healthy, but saw a spike of OOMs on worker-7. grabbing kube logs.
Elena: seeing increased KV cache miss rate and slow downs on redis-eu-1 from metrics. could be correlated.
Mae (oncall): switching to degraded routing policy to route new requests to eu-backup region. executing: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/_reroute -d '{"policy":"eu-failover"}'`
Ravi: traffic reroute applied. monitoring. new request latencies look better but errors still at ~1.2%.
ops-liaison: FYI had a customer email about timeouts 2m ago. tagging Laura for customer comms.
Laura (Customer Success): thanks. I'll prepare a short external note once we have confirmed impact. do we have an initial statuspage draft?
Mae (oncall): starting a quick statuspage draft below. sharing for review — want to keep it concise and accurate.
StatuspageBot: Creating draft for statuspage 'eu-inference-degradation' (draft id: d-9142).
Mae (oncall): ```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Customers in EU may experience increased 5xx errors and higher latencies for text generation. Some requests may time out.
Start time: 2026-03-15T02:34:12Z
What we're doing: Our on-call team is actively investigating and has applied regional routing changes to reduce user impact. We're monitoring error rates and will post updates every 15 minutes or as material changes occur.
Affected services: inference-gateway-eu, redis-eu-1
```
Ravi: nit: change 'Some requests may time out.' to 'A subset of requests may experience timeouts or delayed responses.' also add 'Customer data is not impacted.' to avoid confusion.
Mae (oncall): updated draft: ```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Customers in EU may experience increased 5xx errors and higher latencies for text generation. A subset of requests may experience timeouts or delayed responses. Customer data is not impacted.
Start time: 2026-03-15T02:34:12Z
What we're doing: Our on-call team is investigating. We have applied a regional failover policy to route new requests away from the impacted pool and are monitoring system health and error rates. Engineers are analyzing worker logs and Redis metrics to identify root cause.
Affected services: inference-gateway-eu, redis-eu-1
```
Elena: agree with Ravi. also suggest adding 'Workaround' section to mention reroute was applied and how long it will take to fully take effect.
Mae (oncall): adding Workaround line. ```
Workaround: We have applied an automated regional failover to reduce direct traffic to the affected EU pool. This may reduce throughput for some customers while keeping latency within SLOs. We expect routing to stabilize within ~5-10 minutes.
```
ops-liaison: For internal clarity, can we add a note in the draft for 'Estimated customer impact: ~5% of EU requests' — just ballpark. Should not be too precise if unsure.
Mae (oncall): added as 'approximate'. ```
Estimated customer impact: Approximately 3-7% of EU requests may be affected during peak.
```
Ravi: Approved from infra side. good to publish as initial.
Laura (Customer Success): Approved for external copy. I'll prepare a canned reply for CSMs referencing the statuspage URL and saying we're monitoring.
Mae (oncall): Publishing initial update now. @StatuspageBot, publish draft d-9142 as 'initial'.
StatuspageBot: Published initial update for incident 'eu-inference-degradation' at 2026-03-15T02:43:00Z. Public page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/eu-inference-degradation
Mae (oncall): Posted initial. continuing triage — collecting heap dumps and redis slowlog. will post periodic updates.
Ravi: following up: memory pressure on worker-7 looks like a regression related to a model cache eviction change we rolled out earlier. reverting that config on eu-pool now.
Mae (oncall): revert applied. pointing requests back to eu-primary gradually to validate.
Elena: metrics show errors dropping from 2.8% -> 0.4% over 12 minutes. KV cache hit rate returning.
ops-liaison: I'm drafting an internal postmortem stub to collect timeline — will link once we have resolve.
Mae (oncall): preparing 15-minute update for statuspage. Drafting below for review: ```
Update (15m): We identified a change in model cache eviction behavior that caused increased memory pressure on a subset of worker instances, which in turn led to elevated 5xx errors. We reverted the configuration and applied regional routing to mitigate impact. Error rates are decreasing and throughput is returning to normal. Engineers continue to monitor and run validations. No customer data exposure. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner if things change.
```
Ravi: looks good. maybe add 'affected customers may see transient request failures while we rotated capacity' — small wording tweak.
Mae (oncall): updated. ```
Update (15m): We identified a change in model cache eviction behavior that caused increased memory pressure on a subset of worker instances, which in turn led to elevated 5xx errors. We reverted the configuration and applied regional routing to mitigate impact. Affected customers may see transient request failures while we rotated capacity. Error rates are decreasing and throughput is returning to normal. Engineers continue to monitor and run validations. No customer data exposure. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner if things change.
```
StatuspageBot: Published update (15m) at 2026-03-15T02:58:00Z.
Laura (Customer Success): Sending CSM note now. Template used and linked to status page.
ops-liaison: We're logging timeline in the incident doc: `incidents/2026-03-15-eu-inference-degradation.md` (internal). Will post final link after resolve.
Mae (oncall): monitoring for full stability. will only publish resolved once error rate has been normal for 30m and postmortem skeleton ready.
Elena: errors below 0.1% and latencies within SLO for 25 minutes.
Ravi: no further OOMs on worker pool. heap dumps indicate the eviction delta was the trigger.
Mae (oncall): holding for 5 more minutes, then will post resolved.
StatuspageBot: Automated note: if incident is resolved and confirmed, please run `/incident resolve` to publish resolved notice.
Mae (oncall): `/incident resolve` — Confirming resolved.```
Resolved notice (draft): ```
Status: Resolved
Impact: A subset of EU requests experienced elevated 5xx errors and higher latencies between 2026-03-15T02:34:12Z and 2026-03-15T03:09:00Z. The issue was caused by a model cache eviction change that increased memory pressure on some worker instances. We reverted the change and applied routing mitigation. Error rates have returned to normal. No customer data was exposed.
Next steps: We're conducting a deeper post-incident review and will publish a root cause analysis and remediation plan within 5 business days.
```
StatuspageBot: Published resolved update at 2026-03-15T03:11:03Z.
Laura (Customer Success): Sending final customer wrap-up and flagging accounts with retries.
ops-liaison: Incident doc link posted internally. thanks team. great coordination. :tada:
Mae (oncall): thx all. marking oncall handoff in 30m for followup.
